Subject: Post-demo: SIG initiation and hosting residency clarifications

Alex — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can get the vendor questionnaire moving.

Recap (from our call)
- NovaHealth wants a formal SIG/CAIQ for legal/procurement.
- HIPAA applicability: you flagged that this project will need HIPAA controls and potentially EU residency for a subset of data.
- Procurement timeline: you mentioned an internal decision window by ~Dec 10.

Clarifying asks so we can prefill the SIG and prioritize evidence:
1) Residency: Do you require all production data to remain in EU, or only specific patient datasets? (US hosting acceptable for non-PHI?)
2) SOC 2: What level of assurance do you need on our SOC 2 (Type II report vs SOC 2 + bridge)?
3) KMS/Key residency: Do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) or is provider-managed keys acceptable for now?
4) CAIQ vs SIG: would procurement accept a prefilled CAIQ for initial review while we complete a full SIG?

I've attached a SIG prefill workbook (stub) and a short evidence map template to speed this up. If you prefer, Ben (copied) can run a 30-minute technical walkthrough with your security ops to walk through dataflows and KMS.

Attachments: NovaHealth_SIG_Prefill_20261123.xlsx (prefill template)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novahealth-sig-prefill

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm answers to the four items above (residency, SOC2 needs, KMS, SIG/CAIQ).
- We return a filled CAIQ within 2 business days and a full SIG prefill within 5 days.
- Schedule a tech walk if helpful (Ben/Karthik to lead).

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin — appreciate the recap. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

Answers:
- Residency: We need EU residency for PHI/patient datasets (any analytics or PII tied to EU residents). Non-PHI telemetry and aggregated logs can remain in US.
- SOC 2: Procurement prefers a SOC 2 Type II report but will accept a SOC 2 Type I + bridge if Type II is in-flight with a clear timetable.
- KMS: For PHI we will require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or HSM-backed keys; provider-managed keys acceptable for non-PHI environments.
- SIG/CAIQ: Start us with a CAIQ prefill — legal can ingest that faster, but we'll need the SIG for the security team.

Asks:
- Can you confirm which deployment options support BYOK (Dedicated, Private)?
- Please share any existing network diagram and a sample encryption-at-rest certificate or description.

I'm attaching our high-level vendor questionnaire (just a single sheet with a few vendor-specific fields) in case that helps.

We'd like to keep to our Dec 10 procurement window — can you get the CAIQ prefill to us by end of day Wednesday?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Li

Alex — thanks, helpful. Short answers and what we'll attach to the CAIQ prefill: 

1) BYOK/KMS support
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed keys via HSM/Cloud KMS integrations.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): supports customer-provided keys and on-prem HSMs; full BYOK.
- Hosted/Standard: provider-managed keys only (can be used for non-PHI workloads).

2) SOC 2 status
- Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in progress; expected audit completion and report availability: 2027-03 (Q1 2027). We will include a SOC 2 bridge letter and our current control matrix in the evidence bundle.

3) Residency and partitioning
- We support region pinning for models and storage. We can route PHI datasets to EU-only Dedicated or Private deployments. Non-PHI artifacts can be routed elsewhere per policy.

Attachments we'll send with the CAIQ prefill: 
- Completed CAIQ prefill (partial answers where we need your confirmation)
- Evidence map (who owns each control, expected artifacts)
- Network diagram (redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf)

I've attached the CAIQ prefill workbook (prefilled where possible). Ben / Karthik will own evidence follow-ups; Ben can take the lead on the tech walk with your security ops. 

We can absolutely get a CAIQ prefill to you by EOD Wednesday (Nov 25). Proposed 30-min walkthrough windows: Tue 11/24 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 11/25 09:00-09:30 PT — which works for Maria/security lead?

Attachments: NovaHealth_SIG_Prefill_20261123.xlsx (prefilled CAIQ), redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf
